name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Sit beside the bench, support one forearm on the pad and hold a dumbbell palm-down with your hand beyond the edge.
Allow your hand to bend downward toward the floor under control.
Extend your wrist upward toward the ceiling by contracting the top of your forearm while keeping your arm pressed to the bench.
Lower the dumbbell smoothly back to the start, and switch sides after finishing one arm.
tips: Keep your forearm stationary against the bench instead of lifting your elbow.
Use a light load so you can move through a full range of motion smoothly.
